name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI), annual mean
cite: MODIS MOD13A2 v6.1 vegetation indices (NASA LP DAAC), band NDVI x 0.0001, annual mean, 1 km

name: Enhanced vegetation index (EVI), annual mean
cite: MODIS MOD13A2 v6.1 vegetation indices (NASA LP DAAC), band EVI x 0.0001, annual mean, 1 km

name: Rainfall, annual total
agency: UC Santa Barbara Climate Hazards Center
cite: CHIRPS Daily precipitation (Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara), annual sum, about 5 km

name: Land surface temperature (day), annual mean
cite: MODIS MOD11A2 v6.1 land surface temperature (NASA LP DAAC), band LST_Day_1km x 0.02 minus 273.15, annual mean, 1 km

name: Night-time lights (VIIRS), annual mean radiance
cite: VIIRS Day/Night Band monthly composites (NOAA / Colorado School of Mines Earth Observation Group), band avg_rad, annual mean, about 500 m

name: Permanent surface water, share of area
cite: JRC Global Surface Water yearly history v1.4 (European Commission Joint Research Centre), share of area classed permanent water

name: Tropospheric nitrogen dioxide column, annual mean
cite: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (ESA), tropospheric column, annual mean, about 1 km

name: Air temperature at 2 m, annual mean
cite: ERA5-Land monthly aggregates (ECMWF / Copernicus Climate Change Service), temperature_2m minus 273.15, annual mean, about 11 km
